lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with spatial density increasing in the mid-flank region where the largest spots reside.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots to create a grid-like lattice, where most major spots serve as the nodes of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and a shadow-induced lower intensity below.

other_distinctive_markers: A large remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the lateral flank, positioned posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin's leading edge.
